## Assessing models of the diffusion signals – the precision of the data

![Assessing models of the diffusion signals – the precision of the data.](images/ch58/assessing-models-of-the-diffusion-signals-the-prec.png){#fig-ch58-assessing-models-of-the-diffusion-signals-the-prec}

People have proposed a lot of diffusion models, from the diffusion tensor model on. Fewer people have looked closely at the precision of the data. If you have noisy (imprecise) data, then the ability to distinguish different models is limited. The next set of slides assesses how well we might be able to distinguish different models given the precision of the data.
